configuration: Every official example script in code/quspin/examples/scripts/ that upstream's run_examples.sh runs (the example*.py glob) plus the three user_basis_trivial-*.py files that upstream documents as examples in sphinx/source/examples/, under the examples-scripts group.
observable: observable.json: ground_energy plus the upstream run bookkeeping (which examples ran).
variant: The active binary64 bond coupling changes from J=1.0 to J=1.0000000000001 (450 ulps, dJ/J = 1e-13) before the Hamiltonian is built; the longitudinal field stays at h=0.5.  The field is deliberately not the perturbed input: in a fixed-magnetization sector that term is exactly a constant times the identity, so changing it rescales every level equally and leaves the graded observable at the eigensolver noise floor.  The coupling enters the off-diagonal elements, so perturbing it changes the spectrum.  The step exceeds the two-ulp convention because a two-ulp coupling change is the same size as the repeat-to-repeat ARPACK noise floor and could not be distinguished from it.
warrant: Upstream's own pass condition for this suite is that every example script runs to completion; a non-zero exit status fails the check, and this check excludes no file of the suite.  The graded physical value is the finite spin-chain ground energy on the production path the examples drive, so a broken basis enumeration, operator assembly or eigensolver moves it beyond the measured bound even when the examples themselves still exit zero.
altbuild: none: one pinned Python 3.11 wheel image is used.

evidence.floor_how: Nominal/variant self-validation supplies the measured numerical spread.
